items.title: Reindeer Reading on a Red Cushion
items.alt: Violet-eyed cartoon reindeer seated on a red cushion, with its forehooves resting on an open blank green-covered book.
items.description: The little reindeer tilts its round face above two cream pages. A gold-edged cushion, short antler crown and forward-folded rear hooves create a compact reading scene.

items.title: Reindeer Listening in Red Earmuffs
items.alt: Brown cartoon reindeer standing in red knitted earmuffs and a yellow scarf tied in a bow.
items.description: The reindeer turns its face slightly upward above the bow-tied scarf. Slim legs, small white back markings and a short branched antler crown distinguish the listening pose.

items.title: Reindeer Watching a Snowflake
items.alt: Seated cartoon reindeer gazing up at a large blue snowflake with both forehooves lifted beside its cream chest.
items.description: A single detailed snowflake floats just above the dark nose. Wide antlers, teal eyes and rounded folded legs make the surprised upward-looking pose easy to recognize.

items.title: Reindeer Painting a Gold Star Ornament
items.alt: Curly-forelocked cartoon reindeer painting a gold star on a green bauble supported by a small wooden cradle.
items.description: A short brush touches the star while the other forehoof steadies the ornament. The gold-capped bauble, red paint pot and small supporting cradle form a clear holiday craft scene.

items.title: Reindeer Looking into a Carrot Basket
items.alt: Small brown cartoon reindeer in a green gingham neck bow lowering its nose toward a wicker basket of carrots.
items.description: The animal leans over the basket's arched handle while all four hooves remain visible. Pale cheeks, upright ears and small white back markings distinguish the curious figure.

items.title: Reindeer Watching an Unrolling Ribbon
items.alt: Russet cartoon reindeer turning its head back toward a red ribbon unrolling from a spool beside its rear hoof.
items.description: The curved body and sideways glance lead toward the loose ribbon. Cream cheeks, a short tail and uneven branching antlers distinguish the playful standing figure.
